subject: math.RT
name: Broué abelian defect-group conjecture
statement: Let B be a block of a finite group algebra k[G], where k is algebraically closed of characteristic p, and let its defect group D be abelian. Is B derived equivalent to its Brauer-correspondent block of k[N_G(D)]?
importance: Predicts that the module theory of an abelian-defect block is determined by a local subgroup.
status_note: Known for many defect groups and families of groups; the arbitrary abelian-defect case remains open.

references.title: Rickard, The Abelian defect group conjecture

subject: math.RT
name: Blockwise Alperin weight conjecture
statement: For every p-block B of a finite group G, is the number of irreducible Brauer characters in B equal to the number of G-conjugacy classes of B-weights, pairs (Q,φ) with Q a p-subgroup and φ a defect-zero irreducible character of N_G(Q)/Q whose associated block induces to B?
importance: Would count modular simple modules entirely through local subgroup data.
status_note: Proved for many classes, including recent inductive cases for types B and C and sporadic groups; the general blockwise statement remains open.

references.title: On the inductive blockwise Alperin weight condition for type B and type C

subject: math.RT
name: Alperin–McKay conjecture
statement: For every p-block B of a finite group G with defect group D and Brauer-correspondent block b in N_G(D), are the numbers of height-zero ordinary irreducible characters in B and b equal?
importance: Predicts a local description of the lowest-defect ordinary characters in every block.
status_note: The ordinary McKay conjecture is distinct; this blockwise height-zero conjecture is open in general.

references.title: A Reduction Theorem for the Alperin–McKay–Navarro Conjecture

subject: math.RT
name: Alperin–McKay–Navarro conjecture
statement: For every p-block B with defect group D and its Brauer correspondent b in N_G(D), is there a bijection between their height-zero ordinary irreducible characters equivariant for the stabilizer (H_p)_B of B in the Navarro Galois subgroup H_p, whose automorphisms act as a common power of p on roots of unity of order coprime to p?
importance: Refines local character counting by requiring compatibility with arithmetic Galois symmetries.
status_note: A reduction to inductive conditions is known; the full arbitrary-group Galois-equivariant bijection remains conjectural.

references.title: A Reduction Theorem for the Alperin–McKay–Navarro Conjecture

subject: math.RT
name: Donovan conjecture
statement: For a fixed finite p-group D and an algebraically closed field k of characteristic p, are there only finitely many Morita-equivalence classes of blocks of k[G], as G ranges over finite groups, having defect group isomorphic to D?
importance: Would make the classification of modular blocks with fixed local structure a finite task.
status_note: Known for several families of defect groups; no general fixed-defect-group finiteness theorem is known.

references.title: Donovan’s conjecture and extensions by the centralizer of a defect group

subject: math.RT
name: Brauer’s k(B) conjecture
statement: If B is a p-block of a finite group with defect group D, is the number k(B) of ordinary irreducible characters in B at most |D|?
importance: Predicts a universal size bound on a block from its local defect group.
status_note: Established in many cases, including numerous small or abelian defect groups; the unrestricted conjecture remains open.

references.title: Sambale, Cartan matrices and Brauer’s k(B)-Conjecture V

subject: math.RT
name: Foulkes conjecture
statement: For all integers 1≤a≤b and finite-dimensional complex vector spaces V, does Sym^a(Sym^b V) embed as a GL(V)-representation into Sym^b(Sym^a V)?
importance: Would impose a fundamental positivity ordering on plethysm multiplicities.
status_note: Many small parameters and asymptotic cases are known. The conjecture asks for some equivariant embedding, not injectivity of a particular natural Foulkes–Howe map.

references.title: On the generalised Foulkes conjecture for SL_2(C) under divisibility conditions

subject: math.RT
name: Positive combinatorial computation of Kronecker coefficients
statement: Are Kronecker coefficients g(λ,μ,ν) counting functions in #P when the three partitions of n are given in unary, equivalently counts of polynomial-length combinatorial witnesses with polynomial-time membership tests?
importance: Would provide a positive computational interpretation of symmetric-group tensor-product multiplicities.
status_note: General coefficients are known to have alternating-sum descriptions; membership in GapP does not establish the requested #P counting interpretation.

subject: math.RT
name: Full local Langlands correspondence for split E8
statement: Can the full local Langlands correspondence, including L-packets indexed by enhanced Weil–Deligne parameters and the expected character identities, be constructed and proved for the split group E8 over every p-adic field?
importance: Would extend a central classification of local representations to a major exceptional reductive group.
status_note: General constructions of semisimplified parameters do not give all packet and character-identity properties demanded by the full correspondence.

subject: math.RT
name: Langlands functorial transfer to general linear groups
statement: For a connected reductive group G over a number field, a cuspidal automorphic representation π of G, and an algebraic L-homomorphism r:^LG → ^LGL_N, does an automorphic representation of GL_N exist whose unramified local parameters equal r applied to those of π at almost every place?
importance: Would organize global automorphic representations through their L-group representations.
status_note: Many transfers are established, but arbitrary G and r remain open. The transfer is not required to be cuspidal.
